name: Mizukoshi Moe
source:
Moe is a gentle girl who is often seen throughout the series sitting on the roof at lunchtime cooking and eating nabe with her younger sister, [url=/c4016]Mako[/url]. She is very polite, but can be dim-witted at times, and can fall asleep anywhere at any time, even when she's walking. Sometimes she carries a small xylophone, although it's not because she wants to be a good player of said instrument. She is very knowledgeable about nabe, and can talk for hours about said subject.

[spoiler]In reality, the reason why she sleeps so often is due to her taking sleeping pills to see her deceased childhood friend, Keiichi, in her dreams.[/spoiler]
